bus_policy.cite: Gamebloke project policy: one master cycle per raw request; no WAITCNT or prefetch timing claim.

initialization_policy.cite: Gamebloke deterministic project policy: zero initialize state; hardware power-on RAM values remain unknown.

cpu_policy.cite: Gamebloke deterministic project policy: direct-start CPU initialization, one preflighted interpreter path, and explicit BIOS-none exception stops.
cpu_policy.architecture_cite: ARM7TDMI Technical Reference Manual (DDI 0029G, Issue G), ARM state, Thumb state, and processor modes sections.
cpu_policy.register_banks: User/System share r8-r14, FIQ has private r8-r14, IRQ/SVC/ABT/UND each have private r13-r14, and FIQ/IRQ/SVC/ABT/UND have SPSRs.
supported_opcode_operands: ARM data processing: AND, EOR, SUB, RSB, ADD, ADC, SBC, RSC, TST, TEQ, CMP, CMN, ORR, MOV, BIC, MVN with rotated immediate and immediate/register LSL/LSR/ASR/ROR, defined flags and legal PC/exception-return forms
ARM control flow: B, BL, BX
ARM multiply: MUL, MLA, UMULL, UMLAL, SMULL, SMLAL with S variants and captured operands
ARM status transfers: MRS CPSR/SPSR and MSR register/rotated-immediate c/x/s/f masks, privilege and bank rules
ARM single transfer: LDR/STR byte/word, immediate/scaled-register offsets, P/U/B/W/L and post-index T forms, legal PC operands and writeback
ARM subword transfer: LDRH, STRH, LDRSB, LDRSH with immediate/register offsets, pre/post indexing and writeback
ARM block transfer: LDM/STM IA/IB/DA/DB, writeback, user-bank S forms and SPSR-restoring LDM with PC
ARM swap: SWP and SWPB with ordered read/write and captured operands
ARM exception decode: full SWI imm24, reserved UND and absent CDP/MRC/MCR/LDC/STC coprocessor entry before BIOS-none stop
Thumb formats 1-5: immediate shifts, add/subtract, immediate operations, all 16 register ALU operations and legal high-register ADD/CMP/MOV/BX

Thumb formats 6-12: 6 PC-relative LDR, 7 register-offset transfers, 8 signed byte/halfword transfers, 9 immediate-offset byte/word transfers, 10 halfword transfers, 11 SP-relative transfers, 12 PC/SP address formation
Thumb formats 13-19: 13 SP adjustment, 14 PUSH/POP with LR/PC, 15 STMIA/LDMIA, 16 conditional B, 17 SWI imm8, 18 unconditional B, 19 BL prefix/suffix
Executing project policies: short MUL Rd=Rm and SWP/SWPB Rn=Rd or Rn=Rm snapshot aliases, ARM empty/base-in-list reference rules and isolated BL halves/modulo offset arithmetic
excluded_opcode_operands: Unpredictable operands stop before effects except the explicitly listed executing project policies, including named stops for NV, invalid PC/PSR operands, Thumb same-register MUL, empty Thumb lists and STMIA base-middle/last
Allocated later encodings recognized by the decoder stop as later-architecture-instruction, with no ARMv5+ execution semantics
Unallocated exact-core encodings enter UND, while malformed allocated decode bits are unpredictable
No attached coprocessor or BIOS handler executes, exception entry precedes named BIOS-none stop and vector bytes are never fetched
Static B/BX and ALU-PC target alignment/refill extents retain checked unsupported refusal, not a missing legal instruction family
Original full diagnostic corpus executed locally with admitted fixtures, hosted qualification requires separate exact-head evidence, no hardware, game, BIOS or release qualification is claimed

read_policy.cite: Unverified Gamebloke project behavior: current-latch placeholders for absent BIOS, unsupported I/O, and ROM tails.

unmodeled.reason: Differences between the original console, the SP, and the Micro are not modeled in v1.0. The profile id is agb only; no result may claim behavior of an SP or a Micro.
details: The Internal Memory Control register at 0x04000800 sets the EWRAM wait states; its fastest setting is reported to lock up the Micro (REF, GBATEK, section 4000800h Internal Memory Control).
The Micro has no cartridge switch (REF, GBATEK, section GBA Backwards Compatibility CGB Mode).

unmodeled.reason: The cartridge prefetch buffer is not emulated in v1.0; no result may claim cartridge wait-state or prefetch timing.

Sources disagree on the cycle at which the HBlank flag changes: values of 1,006, 1,007, and 1,008 cycles appear in different sources, and 960 is the visible drawing time, not the flag edge. The profile carries no number for it.
